corrected_policy_description: R21 ranks legal candidate lanes using observed board positions, predicted current-board merge-chain proximity, normal objective target levels, same-level contact proximity, reachable-pair proximity, congestion and danger occupancy. Tied top-ranked candidates use a deterministic seed/state rotation and least-visited lane history. It does not enumerate future spawn sequences or inspect future RNG. These scores remain heuristics; the outcome evidence comes from standard Godot production physics through ShotController.
